summary: Investigated a reported bug where /compact reports 'NOTHING TO COMPACT' on a session with real content, instrumenting buildSessionContext to inspect messages, tokens, and findCutPoint output. Discovered the actual project under development is the user's own gizmo (pi-web) repo, and began tracing the context-fill UI (UsageMeter, usage.ts, SessionUsage, session.usage events in pi-agent-service) to understand when the fill bar appears.
decisions: Confirmed via instrumentation that the failing session (22-49-19) has 45 context messages and estimateContextTokens of 28980 but findCutPoint returns firstKeptEntryIndex 0 / turnStartIndex -1 — bug reproduces in upstream pi-coding-agent compaction.js, not in gizmo itself
Recognized gizmo (apps/agent-server + apps/app) IS the user's pi-web project, so the 'compact UI' under discussion lives in this repo, not upstream
errors: Reproduction: session 22-49-19 (45 messages) reports 'NOTHING TO COMPACT' despite estimateContextTokens=28980 — findCutPoint returns firstKeptEntryIndex=0, turnStartIndex=-1, so messagesToSummarize is empty; root cause not yet located
